_: THE SWEEP THAT SAYS R1255's CONTRACT IS NOT VACUOUS — run it from the
repository root:
cargo run -q --manifest-path tools/injection-harness/Cargo.toml -- \
crates/mnemosyne-atomic/sweeps/generation-cost.sweep.json
WHAT THE CONTRACT IS. R1254 made the schema ladder data and left every row's
`cost` a JUDGEMENT read off that generation's own paragraph — which is how a
row came to say `Breaking` about a store this build opens quite happily.
Each row that claims an old store costs something now carries the store that
shows it: a shape `load` refuses PLUS the same store without it, or — for a
generation that opens and refuses the WRITE — the store and the write.
THE CONTROL IS HALF THE LAW AND THE FIRST INJECTION IS ABOUT IT. A fixture
nobody can parse refuses too, and it refuses in exactly the same shape as a
real retired shape. Without a control that must LOAD, a probe stops probing
the day its fixture rots, and says nothing about it.
ONE INJECTION WAS WRITTEN AND THEN REMOVED, and the removal is the finding.
Recording v24 as `Breaking` again — the misclassification this round found —
does not go red: it does not COMPILE, because the const assertion holds
`Cost::Gated` and `Probe::Boundary` to each other. The harness reported it as
a run over a different target set rather than a firing, which is right. It
was proven by hand instead and the compiler's words are in the round entry.

injections.name: the-probe-keeps-its-refusal-and-loses-its-control
injections.why: the way a probe stops probing without saying so. A malformed fixture refuses exactly as a retired shape does, so a probe whose control is not held to loading proves only that something went wrong. This makes one control unparseable: the retired half still refuses, and only the control catches it

injections.name: the-gated-generations-write-is-let-through
injections.why: the other half of `Gated`, and the half that separates it from `Additive`. A store that opens and whose first write goes through costs its holder nothing, which is what `Additive` says — so the boundary refusing is the whole of the claim

injections.name: an-additive-generation-refuses-the-store-below-it
injections.why: the claim every non-breaking row makes and the one nothing used to check: that an old store simply LOADS. Retiring a shape without recording it as breaking is exactly how a store stops opening while the ladder still reads as free — here the seed store's schema field is refused outright, so every additive row's claim fails at once
